name: @pdpp/polyfill-connectors-vendored-source
description: NOT a workspace package that anything imports by name — see docs/migration/collector-commit-map.txt and this repo's Move R report. This directory holds a closed subset of connector-content and runtime-support source vendored (by physical file, not by npm dependency) into @pdpp/local-collector's build via that package's tsconfig.build.json include list. This package.json exists only to give those vendored files, which live physically outside packages/local-collector/, their own node_modules/zod so npm's directory-based module resolution finds zod@4 (matching local-collector) instead of walking up to the repo root's zod@3. Do not add scripts, exports, or a real identity here — if this ever needs to be a real consumable package, that is Move A's job, not this one.
